availability: past query time minus v1 channel-specific delay; no interpolation; carried values explicitly distinguished from new observations
freshness: same fixed v2 channel caps; BG cap native cadence plus v1 BG delay
context: all repaired v2 point features, including historical profile and up to eight-hour meal summaries, identical information for both methods
matched_comparator: fixed delta XGBoost per horizon on flattened encoded sequence plus identical point context; same final fitting patients and sampled issue rows
targets: same exact v1 issue+30/60 endpoints, missing heads masked; all original evaluation rows retained
row_sampling: deterministic uniform sample of issues with at least one exact target; identical final-fit rows for both methods; separate head masks and equal patient/head loss weight
inner_roles: seeded cadence-stratified selection from each outer fold fitting patients: two five-minute patients plus one fifteen-minute patient for stopping; remaining nine for inner fitting
selection: one architecture and seed; choose epochs by mean patient MAE averaged across heads on inner patients only, then refit from scratch on all twelve fitting patients for that epoch count

training.loss: absolute delta error with head masking and equal total patient/head weights

scaling: sequence value means/std and point imputation/scaling fit only on the relevant inner-fit or final-fit patients; masks/age fractions unchanged
